svg.title: Matmul strategy: K reduction, operand reuse, and grouped blocks
svg.desc: A whole-output grid, separate staging and LDS buffers, and four-wave accumulator ownership show distinct levels of the parameter-tuned matmul.
svg.text: 1024 x 1024 x 1024 | block 128 x 128 x 32 | 1 x 4 waves | one LDS buffer per operand
M: rows down; N: columns right
Cell numbers are logical block IDs.
Inside one block: the reduction loop is K
Global A[row band, K] and B[K, column band]
Copy plans + BufferCopy128b: eight BF16 values / chunk
MMA operands: 16 K values at a time
prefetch -> compute -> reader barrier -> publish -> ready
Outer K loop: 32 stages of 32 values. Each stage has two 16-wide fragment steps.
Green: accumulated | Teal: LDS | Purple mark: staging
K=0..15: M repeat 0, N repeat 1; one WMMA per wave.
Wave 0: reuse A row tile 0 across columns 0 and 4; B column tiles serve all 8 row tiles.
Logical dataflow, not GPU clock timing. Each workgroup independently performs its own K reduction.
